declared_deviation.statement: PROJECT.md says Rust owns the CLI. For D1 the Rust binary natively implements streaming SHA-256 (hash) and typed, metadata-only run-manifest verification (verify-run); FFmpeg/ffprobe orchestration remains owned by the Python workers that the Rust CLI dispatches (probe/clean/demo/export/analyze/report).
